description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans membership table implementation using Azure Cosmos DB. It includes test setup, configurations, and specific test methods for inserting, reading, updating, and concurrency control of membership data within Cosmos DB.

classes.name: CosmosMembershipTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans Membership Table with Azure Cosmos DB backend. It sets up test configurations and contains test methods for verifying membership table operations such as insert, read, update, and concurrency control.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logger filters to monitor CosmosMembershipTable and Orleans.Storage logs at the Trace level.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates a CosmosMembershipTable instance configured for testing, including setting Cosmos DB defaults and options.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates a CosmosGatewayListProvider instance configured for testing.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Returns the Cosmos DB connection string from test configuration.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_Init
methods.description: Test method for initializing the Cosmos membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_GetGateways
methods.description: Test method for retrieving gateway list from Cosmos DB.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Test method for reading all membership entries when the table is empty.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_InsertRow
methods.description: Test method for inserting a membership entry as a Cosmos DB document.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Test method for reading a membership row after insertion.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Test method for reading all entries after inserting some entries.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_UpdateRow
methods.description: Test method for updating a membership row.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Test method for verifying optimistic concurrency during parallel updates using ETags.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Test method for updating heartbeat information in Cosmos DB.
